notes:
Input study identifiers, neutral description, and test locators are empty. The named replication report uniquely identifies its focal hypothesis and final specification, used for replication extraction. The report identifies the original target but is not used as an original-paper statistic source. Original acquisition: DOI title verified; publisher 403 (not retried); Unpaywall and OpenAlex no OA copy; Europe PMC no full text; exact-title search no accessible full text. Supplied replication URL k79vj identifies the report file, not an OSF node; resolved via the supplied reference project tacvb. Report title matches Kim & Radoias (2016), but report date is September 30, 2020 versus reference metadata date 2025. Printed marginal effect retained without conversion. Final replication specification omits DISTANCE; the report also prints a secondary specification with DISTANCE, which is not merged with the focal test. Original and replication use IFLS4 and IFLS5 respectively.
Source follow-up: No description or target locator supplied; multiple predictors and outcomes appear in multiple models. Cannot identify a unique test or analytic sample without inventing a target.
